query: SELECT s.permission FROM share s WHERE s.grantee_id = ? AND ( (s.scope = 'all'   AND s.owner_id = ?) OR (s.scope = 'book'  AND s.scope_id = ?) OR (s.scope = 'group' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM book_group_item gi WHERE gi.group_id = s.scope_id AND gi.book_id = ?)) ) ORDER BY (s.permission = 'editor') DESC LIMIT 1
